items.text: Nvidia’s Stake in SpaceX—and Musk’s Massive Holdings

items.text: SpaceX will try for 1st Starship tower catch 'in a few months,' Elon Musk says
items.summary_cn: Musk表示SpaceX将在数月内尝试首次Starship塔架捕获，星舰测试节奏推进，利好SpaceX相关持仓估值。

items.text: Elon Musk’s Starbase wants to expand in south Texas
items.summary_cn: SpaceX Starbase申请在德州南端扩张，反映Starship产能/测试规模持续放大。

items.text: SpaceX Starship the talk of remote Australian island as Elon Musk’s engineers sent to retrieve it
items.summary_cn: SpaceX Starship成为澳大利亚偏远岛屿热议话题，工程师前往回收，凸显Starship全球影响力与测试进展。

items.author: Trump
items.text: No one has given the Islamic Republic of Iran a greater opportunity to make a Deal than me. TRAGICALLY, for them, they have failed to take it. Therefore, today, I am announcing the MOST CRUSHING ECONOMIC OPERATION EVER TAKEN AGAINST ANY COUNTRY! This will be Economic Warfare and Isolation on an unprecedented scale. Their navy is gone, their air force is destroyed, their military factories are now rubble, their currency is worthless, and their country is hanging by a thread. Today, I am also announcing that ANY country that allows its financial institutions, businesses, airports, or government
items.summary_cn: Trump宣布对伊朗实施史上最严厉的经济战与封锁，任何与伊朗有金融/商业往来的国家都将受连带制裁，能源与避险情绪可能受冲击。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Tesla’s true believers are starting to question their faith in Elon Musk
items.summary_cn: 媒体报道Tesla铁粉开始质疑对马斯克的信仰，Tesla品牌/信仰溢价承压。

items.author: Musk
items.text: GAO finds Elon Musk's DOGE inflated claims of $110 billion in savings for federal government
items.summary_cn: GAO报告指出Musk领导的政府效率部门(DOGE)虚报1100亿美元节省数字，Musk公信力与政治资本遭质疑。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Today, I concluded a deal to substantially lower the price of ground beef for working American families. As everyone knows, under President Biden, beef prices soared at their fastest rate and the American beef herd fell to its smallest size in modern history.  As we work to rebuild this herd and help our ranchers, for the next 90 days, the United States will allow up to 300,000 metric tons of product for ground beef to be imported with no out of quota tariff.  We have a commitment that this beef will be sold at 25 percent below current market prices. This deal will reduce prices for Americans
items.summary_cn: Trump宣布未来90天免税进口30万吨碎牛肉以降低美国国内牛肉价格，涉及农产品进口与关税政策。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Today I am honored to nominate the wonderful Dr. Heidi Overton, MD, PhD, as our next FDA Commissioner. Dr. Heidi has been a ROCKSTAR in my Administration, where she has worked directly with Secretary Kennedy, Dr. Oz, and team, to deliver on the MOST TRANSFORMATIVE Health Agenda in History. She is known to take on the HARDEST issues, and bring me solutions that work best for the Country. Heidi is “ALWAYS RIGHT,” Secretary Kennedy recently said in the Oval Office! We need her leadership at the FDA now to ensure that the U.S. remains the WORLD LEADER for Scientific Discovery and CURES.Dr. Overton
items.summary_cn: Trump提名Heidi Overton为下一任FDA局长，FDA监管走向（药品审批速度）可能影响医药板块。
